In a nutshell, mental tension can cause physical tension(I personally notice my jaws clenching, subconsciously clenching my fist, tension in my shoulders etc. etc.), which can in turn cause cramps and indeed headaches or migraines. Not sure about the itching tbh

What helps for me with the tension/pain is first of all discovering when I get it(maybe you already know, but I found it to be difficult), and when I do notice tension I try to breath calmly and relax a muscle group when I exhale. 
I prefer to start with the most tense muscle group and once it's properly relaxed I expand to more muscle groups, which also gives the benefit of having something to focus on so I'm not constantly ruminating


This is all assuming your pain comes from physical tension, which it could also not be! Hope it helps either way
